classification_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT prop_id) AS distinct_prop_ids FROM cad_property WHERE county_fips='48439' AND tax_year=2026;
SELECT source_vintage, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cad_property WHERE county_fips='48439' AND tax_year=2026 GROUP BY source_vintage ORDER BY n DESC;
SELECT date_trunc('day', ingested_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS ingest_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cad_property WHERE county_fips='48439' AND tax_year=2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH y2026 AS (SELECT prop_id FROM cad_property WHERE county_fips='48439' AND tax_year=2026), y2025 AS (SELECT prop_id FROM cad_property WHERE county_fips='48439' AND tax_year=2025) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM y2026) AS rows_2026, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM y2025) AS rows_2025, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM y2026 j JOIN y2025 o USING (prop_id)) AS overlap_prop_ids, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM y2026 j WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM y2025 o WHERE o.prop_id=j.prop_id)) AS only_2026, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM y2025 o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM y2026 j WHERE j.prop_id=o.prop_id)) AS only_2025;
